screening_decisions.reason: Randomized controlled trial evaluating only systemic intervention (inosiplex) for alopecia totalis. Does not evaluate both topical and systemic interventions.
Randomized controlled trial evaluating only systemic intervention (oral prednisolone) for alopecia areata. Does not evaluate both topical and systemic interventions.

Randomized controlled trial evaluating only topical interventions (betamethasone valerate foam vs. betamethasone dipropionate lotion) for mild-to-moderate alopecia areata. Does not evaluate systemic interventions.

Double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluating only topical intervention (3% minoxidil) for extensive alopecia areata, alopecia totalis, and alopecia universalis. Does not evaluate systemic interventions.
Double-blind trial evaluating only topical intervention (3% minoxidil) for extensive alopecia areata. Does not evaluate systemic interventions.
Randomized double-blind trial evaluating only topical interventions (diphenylcyclopropenone and 5% minoxidil). Does not evaluate systemic interventions.
Randomized trial evaluating both topical (10% cyclosporine, PUVA) and systemic (intravenous thymopentin) interventions for alopecia totalis/universalis. Meets criteria.
Trial evaluating only topical photodynamic therapy (5-aminolaevulinic acid). Does not evaluate systemic interventions.
Randomized trial evaluating only topical cyclosporin A. Does not evaluate systemic interventions.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluating only systemic intervention (imipramine). Does not evaluate topical interventions.
Randomized trial evaluating both topical (squaric acid dibutylester) and systemic (interferon alpha) interventions for chronic severe alopecia areata. Meets criteria.
Double-blind trial evaluating only topical cyclosporin A. Does not evaluate systemic interventions.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluating only topical clobetasol propionate foam. Does not evaluate systemic interventions.
Randomized, controlled trial evaluating systemic (prednisone) and topical (2% minoxidil) interventions for alopecia areata, including alopecia totalis/universalis. Meets criteria.
Observational study and summary of topical minoxidil use. Not a randomized controlled trial evaluating both topical and systemic interventions.
Controlled trial evaluating only topical interventions (squaric acid dibutylester, diphencyprone, minoxidil). Does not evaluate systemic interventions.
Observational questionnaire study. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Theoretical article. Not a randomized controlled trial evaluating interventions.
Randomized trial evaluating only topical aromatherapy interventions. Does not evaluate systemic interventions.
Review article. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Retrospective observational study. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Observational study of prognostic factors. Not a randomized controlled trial evaluating both topical and systemic interventions.
Randomized trial evaluating both systemic (inosine pranobex) and topical (diphencyprone) interventions for alopecia totalis. Meets criteria.
